article.headline: Games To Watch: Unbeaten Brandon meets Warren Central; Oak Grove visits South Jones
article.html:
Brandon’s girls take an unbeaten record to unbeaten Warren Central, Oak Grove’s boys carry a 3–0 start into Ellisville, and Leake Academy brings the same record to the basketball court in Laurel. Those are among the clearest tests of winning starts on Mississippi’s Tuesday, October 27, varsity schedule. All times below are CDT.

Girls soccer: unbeaten teams meet in Vicksburg

Brandon visits Warren Central at 5:30 p.m. The Bulldogs enter 2–0; the Vikings are 1–0–1. Their nonconference meeting is a direct comparison between two teams that have already recorded victories and have yet to lose. Keeping that unbeaten start intact is the immediate measure for each side.

The defensive records sharpen the matchup. Brandon’s posted totals show four goals scored and none conceded; Warren Central’s show three scored and none conceded. This is an early chance to see which attack can break through against another side that has yet to allow a goal in its recorded results.

Soccer in Ellisville: the winning starts switch sides

South Jones brings the established start in the girls match, hosting Oak Grove at 5:30 p.m. The Braves are 2–0, while Oak Grove is listed at 0–0. The girls fixture gives South Jones a chance to extend that winning start and Oak Grove its first posted result.

The records reverse in the 7 p.m. boys match: Oak Grove arrives 3–0, and South Jones is 0–0. Oak Grove’s current totals show 17 goals scored and two conceded. That production makes the boys game worth watching as the Warriors try to carry their early scoring form into another away match, while South Jones gets its first recorded measure of the season.

Soccer in Batesville: Southaven takes two winning records on the road

Southaven’s girls and boys both enter 2–0 against South Panola teams listed at 0–0. The girls play at 6 p.m.; the boys follow at 8 p.m.. Each nonconference game pairs a visitor with wins already recorded against a host seeking its first posted result. The doubleheader offers a useful look at whether both Charger teams can sustain those starts away from home.

Boys soccer on the Coast: Biloxi tests its clean-sheet start

Biloxi visits Long Beach at 7:30 p.m. with a 2–0 record and current totals of five goals scored and none conceded. Long Beach enters 0–0–1. The Coast matchup puts Biloxi’s winning, clean-sheet start against a host that has avoided defeat but is still looking for its first victory.

Basketball: Leake Academy and Simpson build from winning starts

Leake Academy’s boys visit Laurel HomeSchool at 6 p.m. The Rebels enter 3–0, while the Knighthawks are 0–2. That makes the nonconference game a meeting of contrasting starts: Leake has won every recorded outing, and Laurel is seeking its first victory. A home win would give the Knighthawks that breakthrough against a team that has yet to lose.

Simpson Academy’s girls, listed at 1–0, meet 0–0 Silliman Institute at 6 p.m. This is a neutral-site tournament game, listed by MaxPreps as “Brookhaven Aca. Pink Out!” Simpson is trying to follow a winning opener with another victory; Silliman is seeking its first posted result. Our morning edition has the report on Simpson’s opener.
